summary: Executed backend + frontend regression for requested TopPass5 features and prior critical fixes using public preview URL. Core product flows passed, with 3 auth playbook security gaps failing.

critical.issue: No Set-Cookie header / httpOnly session cookie on login response.
Credentialed CORS preflight does not return explicit allow-origin/allow-credentials as required by auth playbook.
No brute-force account lockout after 5 failed attempts; correct password still succeeds immediately after 5 failures.

action_items: Implement secure cookie-based session support (httpOnly, secure, sameSite) for login path if required by auth policy.
Set explicit CORS origins (not wildcard) and ensure credential headers are returned for allowed origins.
Add account lockout/rate-limit behavior after 5 failed login attempts (or align playbook + implementation and update docs/tests).
Update seed_admin startup logic to refresh existing admin password when ADMIN_PASS changes (code-review finding).
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py uses allow_credentials=True with CORS_ORIGINS default '*', which is unsafe/invalid for credentialed auth flows.
seed_admin() updates birthday/L3 fields for existing admin but does not update stored admin password hash if ADMIN_PASS changes.
Advance Mode bypass protection is implemented correctly: /items/{id}/value returns 403 for advance_mode items and passphrase endpoint is enforced.
Layer 3 one-time view policy is correctly enforced with export bypass via ?for_export=true.
seed_data_creation: Created multiple TEST_it11_* users/items during backend regression and UI flow tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated: loading screen -> landing/auth works, wrong password error readable, plus toggle works, admin birthday prompt works, settings theme + auto-lock options + login history load works, value field strength meter weak->strong works, Smart Fill button appears for URL non-advance items, share countdown updates live, advance reveal prompt enforced in UI. Backend confirms Advance Mode API bypass blocked and L3 one-time-view policy intact. Outstanding failures are auth security playbook items (cookie, CORS credential config, brute-force lockout).
rca of the issue: RCA: (1) /api/auth/login returns JWT in JSON body only; no cookie is set, causing missing httpOnly cookie requirement. (2) CORS config in server.py sets allow_credentials=True with wildcard origins (via CORS_ORIGINS='*'), resulting in missing/invalid credentialed preflight headers. (3) Login failure tracking exists but lockout is only enforced under hardcore mode logic; standard 5-fail lockout policy is not implemented, so valid login still succeeds after five bad attempts.
